title: Turn-Based Fight
story: Two fighters take turns. Player 1 always strikes first, and the first to bring the other to 0 or less wins.
goal: Write fight(hp1, dmg1, hp2, dmg2): player 1 hits for dmg1, then player 2 hits for dmg2, and so on. Return "P1" or "P2".
starter:
def fight(hp1, dmg1, hp2, dmg2):
    pass
hints: Use a loop that keeps going until someone is out of health.
Inside the loop, P1 hits first. Check for a winner after each hit.
socratic: Why check after every hit and not once per round?
What happens if the loop never ends?
Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what did you learn from “Turn-Based Fight”?
